title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the equation ρ- = -γ²ρ+.

title: Use of Ampère's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply Ampère's law correctly to find the magnetic field inside the wire.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Gauss' law to determine the electric field within the wire.

title: Equilibrium Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the equilibrium condition where the electric and magnetic forces cancel each other.

title: Neutrality Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should describe how the wire remains neutral despite the charge distribution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the derivation of the charge densities.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
